statements.impact_statement: Golusoris imports no google.golang.org/grpc/xds package and never constructs xds.NewGRPCServer. Govulncheck reports no reachable call path.

braces enters only through tools/spectral/package-lock.json (@stoplight/spectral-cli > fast-glob > micromatch > braces) and runs only in the OpenAPI lint job, on a path named by the workflow file. The v0.16.1 release archives and their SBOMs contain no npm package. No patched braces release exists.
